items.title: Bob Hardaway interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: That show was with Tim Conway, and Harvey Korman, that was as much fun as I ever had watching those guys work.

ctx.x: Oh gee, I’ve heard of some bad habits of musicians, but not that one.

Well I mean, and these people were well to do. I mean as far as musicians go, they did well. And it wasn’t the money, it was the adventure I guess. That’s strange. You know I’m sure there are many — like for instance, I can’t give you specific instances, but on the Carol Burnett Show, Jonathan Winters was a frequent guest there and he was just sensational. And he used to always love to come over to the band area and entertain the band, which he would do. And that was always fun. And that show was with Tim Conway,…
I can’t imagine how you guys would keep playing without laughing.
